text: The JANFteam agent environment provides Java 21 (Temurin LTS), Apache Maven 3.9.16, and Node.js v20 on Linux aarch64.
VAT300 ClcVAT uses truncate-to-4-decimals then half-up rounding (%dech), not half-even; 0.065 rounds to 0.07, not 0.06.
In VAT300, deleted VAT codes (VATDEL='X') are only blocked by ExistVATRate; GetVATRate and ClcVAT still return the stored rate.
chainVATDEF in VAT300 caches the last looked-up VATCODE in the module-level variable; a mid-run VATDEF change for the same code is invisible until a different code is queried.
